OUR STORY & LEADERSHIP

Experience with
a deeper purpose.

Drop By Drop began with a simple belief: sustainable water management should be within everyone’s reach.

Based in Bengaluru and formally registered as Drop By Drop Trust in 2014, our non-profit brings practical water solutions to homes, businesses and communities.

Mr. Suchethana

Director & Rainwater Harvesting Specialist

A veteran development journalist with over two decades of experience in rainwater harvesting, Suchethana combines environmental commitment with hands-on implementation.

His specialist training includes certification from the Karnataka State Council for Science and Technology (KSCST).

Water conservation is
everyone’s business.

Our work goes beyond installations. We champion environmental awareness, natural resource conservation and collaboration with communities, institutions and CSR partners.

A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Still curious? Talk to us about your site and what you have in mind.

+91 94823 30176
Can you design a system for my existing building?

We provide customised solutions for individual homes, apartments and commercial sites. A site survey helps identify suitable collection surfaces, filtration options, storage and recharge opportunities for your property.

What is the difference between storage and recharge?

Storage collects filtered rainwater in a sump or tank for suitable uses. Recharge directs rainwater through an appropriate filtration and recharge system into the ground. A site may benefit from a combination of both.

Do you work on large industrial or agricultural sites?

Yes. Our portfolio includes factories, educational campuses, agricultural applications and rainwater harvesting across eight Avaada solar sites in Karnataka and Maharashtra, with a total project area of 8,000 acres.

Can we organise a workshop or a CSR project?

We conduct field visits and rainwater harvesting awareness workshops. We also collaborate on community initiatives, including government-school installations supported by Gokaldas Exports CSR. Contact us to discuss your community or institution.

How do I get started?

Call, email or send us a WhatsApp enquiry with your location, property type and water challenges. We can then discuss the site assessment and an approach suited to your requirements.
